02 / THE STYLES

Eight ways
to begin.

01 / 08

Bollywood.

Filmi energy, expressive faces and big, joyful choreography made for the spotlight.

02 / 08

Kathak.

Storytelling through rhythm, spins and intricate footwork, rooted in north India.

03 / 08

Bharatanatyam.

Precision, devotion and expressive gesture from South India's classical tradition.

04 / 08

Contemporary.

Fluid, expressive movement that explores emotion, weight and freedom.

05 / 08

Bhangra.

Powerful, celebratory Punjabi folk dance full of energy, rhythm and community.

06 / 08

Fusion.

Where classical roots meet modern styles in choreography that surprises.

07 / 08

Hip Hop.

Groove, rhythm and attitude. Street-born style built on musicality.

08 / 08

Folk.

Regional dances that carry harvest, community and celebration.
